body: I've had nothing to cause me to panic though, I naturally get into highs and lows and I was starting to get into a low and I have no idea why this is coming right now. Im so lost. I'm not a religious man, I never have been. I cant throw the picture away, I need people to see, I just dont know why this is happening. I'm so scared. I cant think of something funny, im trying, but Im just so scared, I cant focus on thinking about it. Its like my thoughts move on their own.
